requirements.title: RANDOM_NUMBER HARVEST restrictions
requirements.definition: HARVEST shall be real, INTENT(OUT), and may be scalar or array.

pending.RANDOM_NUMBER-HARVEST-real: Positive source control calls RANDOM_NUMBER with default-real and nondefault-real HARVEST variables; source-control mutation supplies an integer variable and claims no diagnostic facet.
pending.RANDOM_NUMBER-HARVEST-intent-out: Initialize HARVEST to -0.5, call RANDOM_NUMBER, and assert all elements are in [0,1); mutation removes the call so the sentinel remains outside the interval.
pending.RANDOM_NUMBER-HARVEST-scalar-or-array: Positive source control calls RANDOM_NUMBER with scalar, vector, and rank-two HARVEST variables; mutation changes HARVEST to an unsupported type and claims no diagnostic facet.

requirements.title: RANDOM_NUMBER assigns values in the half-open interval
requirements.definition: RANDOM_NUMBER assigns pseudorandom real numbers from 0 <= x < 1 to HARVEST.

pending.RANDOM_NUMBER-values-ge-zero: Initialize scalar HARVEST to -0.5, call RANDOM_NUMBER, assert HARVEST>=0.0, and mutate by removing the call so the lower-bound check fails.
pending.RANDOM_NUMBER-values-less-than-one: Initialize scalar HARVEST to 2.0, call RANDOM_NUMBER, assert HARVEST<1.0, and mutate by removing the call so the upper-bound check fails.
pending.RANDOM_NUMBER-array-elements-assigned: Initialize a rank-two HARVEST array to -0.5, call RANDOM_NUMBER, assert every element lies in [0,1), and mutate to call RANDOM_NUMBER only on one scalar element so unassigned sentinels remain.
